package.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver_v2
package.description: EtherCAT driver for the Harambe humanoid ankle, v2. The PRIMARY transform is a bicubic fit of the real measured lever->pitch/roll grid (~0.15 deg), which drives the CSP/CST and PVT hardware_interface plugins. The legacy serial-chain ("analytic") model is computed in parallel and published on a separate topic for live comparison only — it is structurally inadequate for this mechanism (>=15 deg vs the grid) and never drives control. Sits alongside the original harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver, selectable by plugin name.
